# State test matrix

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-state-matrix-doc.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Five independent state dimensions describe any fixture the product can show.
They are defined once in [`src/lib/domain/states.ts`](../src/lib/domain/states.ts)
and constrained against each other in [`src/lib/domain/stateMatrix.ts`](../src/lib/domain/stateMatrix.ts).

## Dimensions

| Dimension | Values |
|---|---|
| Fixture lifecycle | `scheduled`, `delayed`, `live`, `finished`, `postponed`, `cancelled`, `abandoned` |
| Data state | `complete`, `partial`, `stale`, `unavailable`, `confirmed_empty` |
| Decision state | `pick`, `lean`, `watch`, `pass`, `withheld`, `unavailable` |
| Publication state | `none`, `draft`, `published`, `corrected`, `retracted` |
| Settlement state | `unsettled`, `won`, `lost`, `push`, `void`, `cancelled`, `pending_verification` |

## Coherence

The unconstrained cross-product is **7,350** combinations.
Most describe situations that cannot exist. Applying the coherence rules leaves
**395** cells — 5.4% of the space.

The reduction is the point: every excluded cell is a contradiction the product
is now forbidden to render, and the exclusions are executable rules rather than
prose. A cell that cannot exist cannot be tested for, and must instead be
prevented.

### Coherent cells by fixture status

| Fixture status | Coherent cells |
|---|---|
| `scheduled` | 47 |
| `delayed` | 47 |
| `live` | 47 |
| `finished` | 83 |
| `postponed` | 47 |
| `cancelled` | 59 |
| `abandoned` | 65 |

### Coherent cells by data state

| Data state | Coherent cells |
|---|---|
| `complete` | 131 |
| `partial` | 131 |
| `stale` | 63 |
| `unavailable` | 7 |
| `confirmed_empty` | 63 |

`unavailable` is the narrowest by design: a failed read constrains the decision to
`unavailable` and forbids publication outright.

## Worked exclusions

Each of these is individually representable and jointly nonsense.

| Combination | Rejected because |
|---|---|
| `scheduled / complete / pick / published / won` | settlement "won" on a fixture that is "scheduled" and has not ended; settlement "won" requires a finished fixture, not "scheduled" |
| `finished / complete / pick / none / won` | settlement "won" with no published claim to settle |
| `scheduled / unavailable / pass / none / unsettled` | data was unavailable but the decision is "pass" — a failed read must stay unavailable |
| `scheduled / complete / lean / published / unsettled` | decision "lean" was published, but only a pick may be published |
| `abandoned / complete / pick / published / won` | settlement "won" requires a finished fixture, not "abandoned" |
| `scheduled / stale / pick / none / unsettled` | a pick was produced from stale evidence rather than withheld |

## Representative cells

The cross-surface suite renders all ten public surfaces for each of these.
Every dimension value appears at least once — enforced by a test, so the set
cannot quietly stop exercising a state.

| ID | Fixture | Data | Decision | Publication | Settlement | Why this cell |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scheduled-complete-pick-published` | scheduled | complete | pick | published | unsettled | The happy path: a published pick before kickoff. |
| `scheduled-partial-lean` | scheduled | partial | lean | — | unsettled | A directional view that did not clear the publication gate. |
| `scheduled-stale-withheld` | scheduled | stale | withheld | — | unsettled | Stale evidence must withhold, never pick. |
| `scheduled-unavailable-read-failed` | scheduled | unavailable | unavailable | — | unsettled | The failed read. Must never render as a considered pass or as zero. |
| `scheduled-confirmed-empty-pass` | scheduled | confirmed_empty | pass | — | unsettled | We looked and there is genuinely nothing. Distinct from the row above. |
| `delayed-complete-watch` | delayed | complete | watch | — | unsettled | Delayed still permits pre-kickoff action language. |
| `live-complete-published` | live | complete | pick | published | unsettled | In play: a score exists and pre-kickoff language must be gone. |
| `finished-complete-won` | finished | complete | pick | published | won | Settled winner. Counts toward the record. |
| `finished-complete-lost` | finished | complete | pick | published | lost | Settled loser. Also counts, and must not be quietly dropped. |
| `finished-push` | finished | complete | pick | published | push | Stake returned. Must not land in the win-rate denominator. |
| `finished-pending-verification` | finished | partial | pick | published | pending_verification | Final whistle but the result is not trusted yet. |
| `finished-corrected` | finished | complete | pick | corrected | won | An append-only correction. The original must remain visible. |
| `finished-retracted` | finished | complete | pick | retracted | void | Withdrawn after publication. Excluded from the record, not deleted. |
| `postponed-unsettled` | postponed | complete | pass | — | unsettled | No score, no settlement, and no countdown to a kickoff that moved. |
| `cancelled-void` | cancelled | complete | pick | published | void | Never played. Void, not lost. |
| `abandoned-void` | abandoned | partial | pick | published | void | Started and stopped: a partial score exists but no outcome. |
| `scheduled-draft` | scheduled | complete | pick | draft | unsettled | Prepared but not public. Must not appear on any public surface. |

## How this is enforced

| Check | File |
|---|---|
| The model agrees with itself | `src/test/state-matrix.test.ts` |
| Surfaces agree with each other | `src/test/cross-surface-consistency.test.tsx` |
| Forbidden states never render | `src/test/prohibited-contradictions.test.tsx` |
| Production rows stay coherent | `scripts/reconcile-truth.mjs` |
